title: Government air-to-air FLIR expert's email on Gimbal rotation
place_text: Off the US East Coast (Gimbal video)

tellings.quote: I'll read it. The object in the video is definitely maneuvering causing the appearance of rotation.
I mean, Mick, we were on on the call with the AT Flare expert. He says, "This is quote bizarre. I've never seen anything like this."
tellings.difference: Quotes the expert on a call calling the video 'bizarre' and unlike anything he had seen, rather than reading an email about the object maneuvering.
tellings.link_reason: Both concern the government ATFLIR expert whom merrick consulted about the Gimbal video and who judged the object anomalous.

plain: In the Gimbal video, a 2015 Navy infrared recording made off the US East Coast of an object that seems to turn in the air, the turning is the object's own movement, according to a government expert in air-to-air infrared imaging. Marik von Rennenkampff, a national security writer, reads the expert's email aloud on the show in a debate with Mick West, a skeptic who explains UFO videos in everyday terms: 'The object in the video is definitely maneuvering, causing the appearance of rotation.' Von Rennenkampff also reminds West that they were both on a call with the expert, who called the video 'bizarre' and said 'I've never seen anything like this.' If the expert is right, it would mean the turning is not just a trick of the camera.
